thread:
Lena Ortiz: Need help
 I went full-time 2024-06-01, switched to Redwoodplan, but my dentist billed on 2024-06-05 for a 2024-05-28 root canal (service before my effective date). They say they submitted after my new coverage started and it auto-paid under the new plan which has a higher copay. I paid $250. Can we get this reprocessed under my previous plan?

Maya - People Ops: Hi Lena 
 short answer: if service date is 2024-05-28 and prior insurer was still active on that date, claims should be processed by the prior plan. Sometimes providers bill late and the clearinghouse routes to current active plan, which causes the issue. Two paths: 1) get provider to rebill with original insurer (preferred), 2) we request a coordination of benefits (COB) correction with the carrier. Do you have the EOB or payment receipt from the dentist?

Lena Ortiz: I have the superbill and the receipt showing they charged me and marked it "processed" under Redwood. I also have my prior plan card scan.

Benefits Bot: Upload both docs to Benefits Portal > Claims Help. Tag People Ops. For COB requests we need: service date, provider NPI, claim ID (if on EOB), and the superbill. Deadline: 120 days from service date for audit window.

Claims Team: If provider rebills to the prior insurer we can void the RW payment and coordinate a refund. If they refuse, we can escalate to the carrier to reassign primary responsibility based on service date. Typical turnaround 3-6 weeks. If Finance Ops is needed for reimbursement to you, tag them with receipts.

Finance Ops: If carrier retroactively reassigns responsibility and refunds are issued to us, we'll process reimbursements to you within one pay cycle. Keep originals for reimbursement audit.

Lena Ortiz: Uploaded docs and DM'd provider billing contact to ask for rebill. Thanks everyone.

Maya - People Ops: Thanks Lena. I'll open a carrier case now and assign to Claims Team. We'll update this thread when we have confirmation or if we need more info. Reminder: do not post member IDs publicly; use portal or DM.
